title: DZR-030…DZR-200 - Deesys round ZCT (zero-phase CT), 200 mA / 100 mV
range_short_desc: Round cable-through zero-phase current transformer for ELD / GFR
description: Deesys DZR round (cable-through) zero-phase sequence current transformer for earth-leakage detectors and ground-fault relays. Voltage-output type with a zero-phase current ratio of 200 mA / 100 mV (75–125 mV at 2 kΩ). Window sizes from Ø30 up to Ø200 mm covering rated currents from 100 A to 2000 A. Note the output is a voltage type suited to ELD and static-type relays, so it cannot be applied to induction-type relays.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
